annotations.title: Request a number from another vendor

description: Pass along a person's request for a toll free number held by another vanity number vendor, the kind check_number and the searches show as with another vendor, with no list price. Use it when the person asks to request that number and gives their name and email. Bill Quimby at VanityNumbers.com reviews each request by hand to confirm it's available and what it would cost, and answers by email, usually within a day; it costs nothing to ask. Returns whether it was sent and what happens next. It can't buy or reserve the number.

email.description: The person's email address. Bill answers there.
email.title: Email

message.description: Optional: anything the person wants Bill to know, like what the business does.
message.title: Message

name.description: The person's name, for Bill's reply.
name.title: Name

number.description: The toll free number, by digits or spelling, like 844-393-2273 or 844-EYE-CARE.
number.title: Number
